summary: Hard cap on the number of stops on the vehicle's route (breaks/layovers not counted).
range: Non-negative integer. A shipment consumes TWO stops (pickup + delivery).
constraints: Served stops on the route must be <= max_stops.
businessRules: Tasks beyond the cap go to other vehicles or result.unassigned.
max_stops 0 makes the vehicle effectively unused.

max_stops defines: Specify the maximum number of stops that the vehicle can make. Whenever the vehicle makes a stop during a trip, it is counted against the “max\_stop” constraint. Vehicles stopping for breaks or lay…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.max_tasks. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: max_stops 8 with 8 eligible jobs — all served.
Boundary: 9th eligible job with max_stops 8 -> unassigned or reassigned.
Infeasible: fleet cap below total eligible demand forces unassigned.
Interaction: Boundary: max_tasks 5 with 6 eligible jobs -> the 6th is reassigned or unassigned.
Interaction: Combination: two vehicles each max_tasks 5, 12 jobs -> >=2 unassigned.
